mana costs may gate casts across a sustained 15s rotation

Pyromania stacks (up to 4) built by spell hits/casts, consumed by next Q/W/R cast for Energized stun
Energized cast stuns the target; stun itself doesn't matter for damage fight but the consumption mechanic and stack-gating do

shield amount, damage reduction, movement speed are non-damage utility

needsBespoke.why: Tibbers (R) is a pet/summon whose ongoing attack and aura damage against the dummy over the ~45s lifetime (attack damage, attack speed decay, aura tick, AP ratio) isn't captured by a single 'pet-or-summon' primitive value the same way the numbers sheet structures it (per-attack AD+AP with a decaying attack-speed debuff, plus a separate AP-scaling aura DoT). A simulator needs bespoke logic to model Tibbers' independent attack timer and aura ticks over the fight duration, not just a flat pet-damage number. Additionally, the Pyromania stack/consume interaction (stacks build from hits, gate an empowering stun onto whichever of Q/W/R lands first) is timing-sensitive and needs bespoke sequencing logic beyond a generic 'target-stacks' primitive, though it does not add extra damage itself.

proposal: Start the fight with Pyromania already at 4 max stacks (game-start default) and Energized active.
Open with Q (Disintegrate) to consume Energized for the stun (irrelevant to a passive dummy, but consumes stacks) and deal its magic damage.
Cast R (Summon: Tibbers) on/near the dummy for its initial burst damage, applying the magic penetration passive for the rest of the fight.
Cast W (Incinerate) on cooldown, angled to hit the dummy.
Cast E (Molten Shield) once for the Pyromania stack contribution (its own damage term never fires against a non-attacking dummy).
Repeat Q on cooldown (its 4s cooldown is shortest); weave W every 7s; let Pyromania stacks rebuild every 4 spell casts/hits and consume automatically on whichever qualifying spell lands next.
Track mana against costs (Q 60-80, W 70-90, E 60-80, R 100) to see if the 15s window is resource-constrained at low mana pools/levels.
Let Tibbers continue attacking/aura-ticking the dummy for the remainder of the 15s after his summon, per the unsettled Tibbers-inclusion question.
